summary: Abel Palmer, 21, of Durango, killed by a skier-triggered soft-slab avalanche (SS-AS-R3-D2-O/G, ~240-ft crown) he drifted into on the south side of Red Mountain Pass (Sam's Trees area) while descending with a companion; the companion located him with a transceiver and dug him out by ~1:28 p.m., and friends performed CPR for roughly 3 hours; SAR reached the scene at 4:40 p.m. and transported him by rescue sled then snowmobile to an ambulance on the highway
location: Sam's Trees, south side of Red Mountain Pass
notes: CAIC full accident report quoted by SnowBrains; date weekday-verified (Sunday 2018-01-21). Pair had reviewed the CAIC forecast that morning and planned to avoid the gully but drifted left of their planned rib. Second avalanche hit the companion and buried him to the waist; no cell service at scene, so another party skied to the highway and called 911 at 2:24 p.m. CAIC report names only 'SAR'; jurisdiction is San Juan County. Run 147, Silverton/San Juan roster chunk. | Run 173: CAIC classic 2017-18 table (opened this run) says 2 skiers caught and partially buried, 1 killed — victim count corrected 1 to 2.
